cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Let Go of the Grudge
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender resentment, distance, or a claim that keeps the relationship stuck.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Let me help you move. Missing your birthday shouldn't mean I'm banned from every box.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I needed you then. You didn't show.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I know. I'm here now. Give me one thing you can bear to trust me with.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The birthday glasses. Still wrapped, since nobody came.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll carry them carefully. Could we unwrap two at your new place?

mechanism: A offers professionally careful moving help to regain limited trust after missing a birthday, then uses the offered glasses for a concrete shared moment beyond the grudge.
confusable: D77 shares a burden as relationship duty; D84 asks B to loosen exclusion rooted in resentment over a specific failure.
comparison: Dinner alternative invites hurt account at close seating; moving alternative uses careful handling and shared unpacking to reopen connection.
seedUse: Missed birthday, moving boxes and unused birthday glasses derive from D84-b; S03 adds packing and handling corrections.
